dct_title_s: Bolivia (Plurinational State of) - Subnational Administrative Boundaries
dct_description_sm: Bolivia (Plurinational State of) administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 02. Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
